sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface expression confirmed by surface assay (KCNC1-HA detected at the plasma membrane); channel function not explicitly re-measured in the tagged construct in this study.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly names T231 as the insertion point for the HA tag in the first extracellular loop of full-length, membrane-anchored KCNC1. Python confirms residue 231 is T (residue_before=T, residue_after=Q), sits within the extracellular span 210–246, and is 22 residues from the TM1 C-boundary and 16 residues from the TM2 N-boundary, satisfying the ≥3-residue clearance rule on both sides. The construct was used for cell-surface expression assays, demonstrating successful trafficking to the plasma membrane. Full-length KCNC1-HA construct with a 9-aa HA tag inserted after T231 in the first extracellular loop (S1–S2 linker, topology residues 210–246); used in cell-surface expression assays in a heterologous expression system.

sources.claim: For cell-surface expression assays, KCNC1 -HA was synthesized to include an HA tag (YPYDVPDYA) attached to the first extracellular loop behind T231 as described previously ( Xu et al., 2007 ).

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) was provided. It unambiguously pins the HA-tag insertion to T231 in the S1–S2 extracellular loop of full-length KCNC1. No other extracellular loops, termini, or alternative positions are supported by the ledger. The N-terminus (residues 1–190) is intracellular and the C-terminus (434–511) is intracellular, so neither terminus is available for a surface tag. The remaining extracellular loops (S3–S4 linker 292–314 and S5–S6/turret 367–412) have no ledger support and are not proposed.
